subject: Initial SOC 2 Type II intake — audit period & what to share
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@greenpay.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: security@greenpay.com
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask and audit period

Hi Ben —

We're kicking off vendor intake for GreenPay's upcoming audit and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II materials and a short bridge letter confirming the audit period and any known coverage gaps. High-level asks:
- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent) or attestation letter if report not yet published
- Bridge letter confirming audit period (we expect the period to be Jan 1, 2027 — Dec 31, 2027 unless you advise otherwise)
- Minimal evidence manifest (list of artifacts + owners) and any secure transfer instructions (SFTP/presigned links)

Can you confirm:
1) whether the report is available and the audit period you cover
2) preferred secure transfer method and point of contact for technical uploads

We're targeting our vendor review by May 31. If helpful we can set a 30-min intake call this week.

Thanks,
Laura Chen
Security Program Manager
GreenPay Inc.

Attachment: SOC_request_instructions.pdf (instructions summary)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask and audit period

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the note and the clear list. Quick answers up front:
1) We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering the period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31. The full report is available under NDA; we typically provide the report PDF plus a short bridge letter.
2) Preferred transfer options: pre-signed S3 links or an SFTP endpoint (we can provide either). For bulk evidence we usually ask auditors to pull via presigned links — that's fastest.

What we'll share now (preparing):
- Signed SOC 2 Type II report PDF (redacted where necessary)
- Bridge letter confirming the audit period and a short note on coverage (template attached)
- Evidence manifest (CSV) mapping artifact name -> owner -> access method

Next steps I propose:
- I'll loop in Karthik (security) to confirm the evidence manifest contents and to provide the transfer details.
- If you want a short intake call, Kimberly can coordinate availability.

Kimberly — can you propose two 30-min slots tomorrow/Thu for a short intake?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachments: SOC2_TypeII_bridge_letter_template.docx (bridge letter template), evidence_manifest.csv (starter manifest)

Laura —

Following up with technical detail and what we'd expect from GreenPay to complete the intake:
- Audit period: Confirmed. Our report covers 2027-01-01 through 2027-12-31. The bridge letter will state that explicitly and list any scoped exclusions.
- Evidence manifest: attached is a starter CSV (evidence_manifest.csv) with suggested artifact names and owners. Please flag any items you don't need or want expanded.
- Transfer options: we can provide presigned S3 links for each folder (recommended) or set up an SFTP user for Blue Ridge Audit. Provide preferred method and the upload contact. If you choose presigned links, we will produce them with 7-day TTL and can revoke as needed.
- Redactions: if you require redacted copies, note which fields should be removed; we can deliver both redacted and unredacted to auditors with an NDA.

I can be the technical POC for evidence transfer: karthik_iyer@redwood.com. For anything policy-related (scope, legal), Kimberly is on copy.

Proposed intake call times (PST): Thu 2028-05-17 10:00 or 15:00. Kimberly — please confirm which works for GreenPay.

Regards,
